GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARDPILE_GU_ACTIVE.de: Holds up to 5 Gu ready to activate. Empty slots are filled from Gu Waiting in order.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARDPILE_GU_STORAGE.d: Holds recovered Gu waiting for an active slot.
Gu with no uses left recover here, then join the waiting queue.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_SECONDARY_RESOURCE_YU: A separate combat resource spent to activate Gu. Refilled on the first turn of each combat; afterwards it restores every turn by aperture rank. Ranks 1-9: capacity 3/4/4/5/5/7/7/8/9, recovery 1/2/2/2/2/3/3/4/4.
